## About

db firmware (om-c-firmware) by azqeurio publishes beta firmware patches for a wide range of bodies, including the OM-1, OM-1 Mark II, OM-3, OM-5, OM-5 Mark II, E-M1 Mark III, E-M5 Mark III and PEN-F. The repository's README is minimal; the release notes, partly in Korean, describe each version.

Recent releases list aperture-ring support for Panasonic lenses, extra burst rates on the OM-1, a 5 GHz hotspot, the electronic shutter sound through the speaker, Korean menus and, in v0.4.1, a Quasi-LUT feature with transfer to the camera through DBLink.

The author owns only some of the supported bodies and says the patch can't be guaranteed to work on every model. v0.4.1 lists known issues for the OM-5 build.

The v0.4.2 beta notes list Hybrid Shutter for the OM-3 and OM-5 Mark II, and changes to the separate OM-5 build based on Mark II firmware. v0.4.3 extends Hybrid Shutter to S and M mode and lists it for nine bodies, fixes Quasi-LUT conversion, grain and the OM-3 indicator, and lists the OM-5 and OM-5 Mark II builds as not working.

The maintainer reports power-cycle persistence for Hybrid Shutter and Quasi-LUT in v0.4.3b, then a simulated OM-5 boot fix in v0.4.4 and follow-up fixes in v0.4.4b.

v0.4.6 adds Quasi-LUT to the OM-5, OM-5 Mark II, the Mark II-based OM-5, E-M1X, E-M1 Mark III and E-P7. The Korean notes say most of the new user interface is ported to the E-M1 Mark III; the English notes leave out "most".

<div class="feature-card" markdown="1">

**Korean menus** <span class="pill pill-beta">Beta</span>
{ .feature-head #feature-korean-menus }

Korean language support on several bodies.

[OM-3](../cameras/om3.md), [OM-5](../cameras/om5.md), [OM-5 Mark II](../cameras/om5-ii.md)
{ .card-meta }

</div>

<div class="feature-card" markdown="1">

**Quasi-LUT and DBLink** <span class="pill pill-beta">Beta</span>
{ .feature-head #feature-quasi-lut-and-dblink }

Quasi-LUT with DBLink transfer. On OM-3, v0.4.3b adds power-cycle persistence for the on/off state and selected slot. v0.4.6 lists it for the OM-5, OM-5 Mark II, the Mark II-based OM-5, E-M1X, E-M1 Mark III and E-P7.

[OM-3](../cameras/om3.md), [OM-5](../cameras/om5.md), [OM-5 Mark II](../cameras/om5-ii.md), [OM-D E-M1 Mark III](../cameras/em1-iii.md), [PEN E-P7](../cameras/ep7.md) · since dbv0.4.1
{ .card-meta }

</div>

<div class="feature-card" markdown="1">

**Focus stacking with any lens** <span class="pill pill-beta">Beta</span>
{ .feature-head #feature-focus-stacking-with-any-lens }

v0.4.6 removes the lens restriction on in-camera focus stacking on the bodies that support it. The notes do not list those bodies.

since dbv0.4.6
{ .card-meta }

</div>

<div class="feature-card" markdown="1">

**New user interface on the E-M1 Mark III** <span class="pill pill-beta">Beta</span>
{ .feature-head #feature-new-user-interface-on-the-e-m1-mark-iii }

The Korean notes say most of a new user interface is ported to the E-M1 Mark III; the English notes call it a new UI port. No list of screens is given.

[OM-D E-M1 Mark III](../cameras/em1-iii.md) · since dbv0.4.6
{ .card-meta }

</div>

<div class="feature-card" markdown="1">

**OM-1 Mark II features on the OM-1** <span class="pill pill-beta">Beta</span>
{ .feature-head #feature-om-1-mark-ii-features-on-the-om-1 }

A port of OM-1 Mark II firmware to the OM-1, without ND128 or the larger buffer.

</div>

<div class="feature-card" markdown="1">

**12.5 and 16.7 fps bursts** <span class="pill pill-beta">Beta</span>
{ .feature-head #feature-12-5-and-16-7-fps-bursts }

Extra burst rates on the OM-1 with the SH2 shutter mode.

</div>

<div class="feature-card" markdown="1">

**5 GHz hotspot and shutter sound** <span class="pill pill-beta">Beta</span>
{ .feature-head #feature-5-ghz-hotspot-and-shutter-sound }

A 5 GHz Wi-Fi hotspot, and the electronic shutter sound through the speaker.

</div>

<div class="feature-card" markdown="1">

**Hybrid Shutter** <span class="pill pill-beta">Beta</span>
{ .feature-head #feature-hybrid-shutter }

Switches to the electronic shutter on overexposure in P or A mode and, since v0.4.3, below the slowest mechanical speed in S or M mode. In v0.4.3b the project adds retention of the selected mode across power cycles.

[OM-3](../cameras/om3.md), [OM-5 Mark II](../cameras/om5-ii.md), [OM-5](../cameras/om5.md), [PEN E-P7](../cameras/ep7.md) · since dbv0.4.2
{ .card-meta }

</div>

**PEN-F:** The release names this camera without saying which features it adds. [Read release notes](https://github.com/azqeurio/om-c-firmware/releases/tag/dbv0.3.2).

## Research notes

The latest reviewed release is v0.4.6 beta, which lists Quasi-LUT on six more bodies, most of a new user interface ported to the E-M1 Mark III, and focus stacking with any lens on bodies that support it. The README says the maintainer tests on real OM-1, OM-5 Mark II and E-M10 bodies only; other models are checked in offline simulation. The release notes add no physical-camera result.
